def decimal_to_fraction(decimal_str, repeat_length):
    # Split the decimal string into non-repeating and repeating parts
    non_repeating, repeating = decimal_str.split('.')
    
    # Convert non-repeating and repeating parts to integers
    non_repeating = int(non_repeating)
    repeating = int(repeating)
    
    # Calculate the length of the non-repeating part
    non_repeat_length = len(non_repeating)
    
    # Create the numerator and denominator
    numerator = int(non_repeating + repeating) - int(non_repeating)
    denominator = 10**repeat_length - 1
    
    # Adjust the denominator based on the length of the non-repeating part
    if non_repeat_length > 0:
        numerator += non_repeating * (10**repeat_length)
        denominator *= 10**non_repeat_length
    
    # Simplify the fraction using the greatest common divisor
    common_divisor = gcd(numerator, denominator)
    numerator //= common_divisor
    denominator //= common_divisor
    
    return f"{numerator}/{denominator}"
